newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM orders more cost-efficient public works.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM orders more cost-efficient public works.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto has asked government ministries to set numerical targets by April to make public works spending more efficient and so cut costs, Trade Minister Shinji Sato told a news conference on Tuesday.

"Many problems associated with public works have been pointed out. Cutting public works costs is one of the biggest problems facing our country...We need to set specific numerical targets that the people will easily understand," Hashimoto was quoted as saying.
Sato said the prime minister asked government ministries and agencies to set the numerical targets by the end of the current business year on March 31.
